title: Install or recover Conversations
summary: Install matching validated Conversations artifacts or select a verified retained release, then check runtime and published documentation.
use_when: An explicitly authorized manual Conversations installation or retained-release recovery is needed.
do_not_use_when: Ordinary CI delivery, release publication, task mutation, authentication, or history retrieval is the request.
outcome: The intended verified binary and provider release are selected together, with a separate runtime readiness check.
effects: Changes product binary and Chancery provider selectors; registers command inventory.
A separate doctor check launches App Server for metadata readiness without repair or turn reads.
authority: The operator authorizes installation or recovery. Conversations owns only its product paths and provider selector.
success: Matching tested artifacts or a verified retained release are selected; usage inventory, doctor, and installed-document checks establish the intended selection and observed readiness.
failure_and_recovery: Stop on stale or foreign selectors, failed integrity checks, or unverified restoration. Preserve diagnostics and selected releases before retrying deliberately.
privacy: Provider bundles and examples contain no real transcript or credential; diagnostics remain private.

CLI usage recording requires a nonempty CODEX_THREAD_ID. Chancery records command identity, time, and thread ID, not arguments, output, or outcomes. Internal product calls are excluded; recording errors do not change results.
steps: Read conversations.runtime and nucleus manual, select matching validated artifacts, and confirm installation authority.
Install with the tested installer, binary, and bundle, or recover a canonical verified retained release.
Register usage, run doctor in the operator environment, and inspect product/show/resolve through Chancery.
checkpoints: The selected binary and complete provider bundle agree.
No service starts, credentials are imported, transcripts are read, or foreign paths are replaced during installation.
Runtime readiness is checked separately; embedded consumers are rebuilt and deployed when library behavior changed.
adaptation: Use an explicit expected-current guard for concurrent installation callers. Recovery supports both documented release formats.
stop_when: Ownership, release integrity, current-selection freshness, or restored selectors cannot be verified.
does_not_authorize: Release publication, CI submission, task mutation, transcript disclosure, authentication changes, or removal of foreign paths.

consumers.statement: An operator authorized for manual installation or recovery may select validated Conversations artifacts.

preconditions.statement: Matching tested binary, Rust installer, and complete bundle or a canonical owned retained release are available; installation authority is established.

inputs.statement: Tested installer/binary/bundle paths or an absolute retained-release directory; optional expected-current absent or releases/HASH guard.

outputs.statement: Verified product and provider selectors, command inventory registration, and separate runtime/document observations.

data_semantics.statement: Installation publishes retained bytes and changes selectors. Doctor is a separate metadata-only readiness operation; Chancery reads documentation only.

identity_and_units.statement: Content-addressed release HASH identifies exact installed bytes; entry version and Codex version remain distinct.
This procedure defines no cost, schedule, or accounting unit.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Completion checks exact selected release, complete published bundle, and invocation-time App Server handshake. A declared upstream gap remains a gap, not an installation failure.

access.statement: The current-user operator uses validated local artifacts and product-owned paths; no foreign-selector, task, raw-store, or credential authority is granted.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Required runtime guarantees supply locks, atomic publication, stale guards, verified restoration, and retained-release recovery. The operation starts no service and reads no transcript.

operational_limits.statement: Ordinary delivery remains the Cell CI manager route. Manual publication and CI submission are outside this installation procedure.
No manual installation duration or deployment schedule is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: The operation uses conversations.runtime contract 1 and supports verified previous shell releases and cell-install-v2 without executing retained installers for verification.

reliances.statement: Installation integrity and process/readiness semantics are owned by the required Conversations runtime feature.
